changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6124-view-handler-keys-are-event-names.md`

- names `plugin-view/src/__tests__/handlerEventNameLiveness.6124.test.tsx` → `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/handlerEventNameLiveness.6124.test.tsx` — edited by this change

  > The correction also protects the capability. A handler-key census that buckets by declared TYPE cannot tell an event name from the unsupported handler-expression dialect, and on that reading these three had been swept in for retirement, which would have deleted working behaviour. A new pin (`plugin-view/src/__tests__/handlerEventNameLiveness.6124.test.tsx`) now holds both halves — that each key is DECLARED on the authorable surface, and that the authored string reaches `new CustomEvent(...)`.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `f99f9cde7` (merge-base with origin/main): 6 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1500 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2084 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36148480375)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `528b56d6e7cf62f8d1fdf00a67a6f0569a593a36`

### ① Derived judgments

- **Event contract.** `viewHandlerChannels.ts` takes `eventName` straight from `schema.onChange` / `schema.onViewChange` at the three call sites (FilterUI.tsx:101, SortUI.tsx:95, ViewSwitcher.tsx:277) and dispatches `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(eventName, { detail }))`. Details are `{ values: nextValues }`, `{ sort: nextSort }`, `{ view: nextView }`, matching `views.zod.ts` describe text at lines 368, 402, 327 (`detail: { values }`, `{ sort }`, `{ view }`, "dispatched on window"). Absent or empty-string `schema.KEY`: the `if (eventName && typeof window !== 'undefined')` guard skips dispatch, no throw. A non-string truthy value (not authorable: the mirror is `z.string()`, and the 6124 pin asserts a function fails parse) is coerced by the `CustomEvent` constructor and dispatched without throwing, identical to base. The authored string is never called: the prop slot is called only under `typeof hostCallback === 'function'`. One nuance, not a regression: a function placed on `schema.KEY` by a TS host would also be spread into the prop slot and called, exactly as base did.
- **Both channels.** True at source. `SchemaRenderer.tsx` destructures `({ schema, ...props })` (line 900); the metadata strip (lines 1959 to 2001) removes type, children, body, schema, visibility and enablement keys, dataSource, testId, objectFields, responsiveStyles, and leaves `onChange` / `onViewChange` in `componentProps`; `createElement` (lines 2194 to 2228) spreads `schema: schemaForComponent`, then `...outgoingComponentProps`, `...outgoingPropsBag`, aria, debug, then `...props` LAST. So a host function wins the prop slot and the authored name stays on `schema`. Host-function-only path (for example `ObjectView.tsx:2602` renders `ViewSwitcher` directly with `onViewChange={handleViewTypeChange}`): function called, no window event unless the schema names one, same as base. Order host-then-event is unchanged from base (`onChange?.(next)` preceded the dispatch in all three).
- **One helper, no drift.** The only `dispatchEvent` / `new CustomEvent` in plugin-view non-test source is `viewHandlerChannels.ts:52`; each component reads `schema.KEY` and the prop exactly once, inside `notifyChange`. `views.zod.ts` has exactly three string-typed `on*` keys (326, 367, 401); `onBack`, `onNavigate`, `onAddComment` are `handlerKeyRefusal` runtime slots. The only other "Event name" describe under `packages/types/src/zod` is `crud.zod.ts:139` `tracking.event`, nested and never spread. No other component has the shape.
- **Pins.** `handlerEventNameThroughRenderer-10616.test.tsx` imports the real `SchemaRenderer` and the real registry (`import '../index'`), no `vi.mock`. Re-run in a scratch worktree (offline install, vitest source aliases): HEAD `Tests 14 passed (14)`; all three components at BASE `3 failed / 11 passed`, `reported` holding `TypeError: onChange is not a function` twice and `TypeError: onViewChange is not a function` once; ablations FilterUI, SortUI, ViewSwitcher each `1 failed / 13 passed`, the matching authored leg only. Mutation proven on disk before each run (helper count 0, bare `?.(` count 1) and restore proven (`git diff HEAD` empty). The 6124 pin change is comment-only: zero non-comment changed lines, `vi.mock('@object-ui/react')` and all 8 tests untouched.
- **Docs finding.** Real: `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md:1302` reads "| `onViewChange` | `string` | Expression or callback invoked on view change. |" at HEAD and at current main; it contradicts the `views.zod.ts:327` describe. The PR's changeset and the pending 6124 changeset both say the key is the NAME of a `CustomEvent`, so neither repeats it. It predates this card (a 6124 leftover), is outside the claimed surface and reaches the doc gates, so it is not in scope here. A card is owed: the dev noted it in the PR body only and filed nothing. Related drift the PR did not mention: `packages/types/src/views.ts` JSDoc for all three keys (lines 1034, 1155, 1260) cites "Read at `plugin-view/src/ViewSwitcher.tsx` (FilterUI, SortUI) as `new CustomEvent(schema.KEY, …)`"; after this PR that expression lives only in `viewHandlerChannels.ts`. These are symbol citations, not banned line addresses, and the file is in `@object-ui/types`, so a follow-up (fold into the docs card) rather than a blocker.

### ② Semver level

`patch` and `Clause-②: no` hold. `packages/plugin-view/src/index.tsx` does not export `viewHandlerChannels` or `notifyViewHandlerChannels`; `package.json` exports only `.` to `dist/index`; the helper is imported by the three components only. Exported prop types, zod mirror and registrations are unchanged. New changeset: every sentence true against the diff and the re-run legs, with one overstatement: "SchemaRenderer also passes every node key to the component as a React prop" (it strips the metadata set listed above; the load-bearing clause, that the authored string reaches the same-named prop, is true). Pending 6124 changeset: md5 `ccd92197c632d2b200478176ac6d1a95` at BASE, HEAD and main; its sentences (the string is the name of a `CustomEvent` the renderer dispatches on window; nothing an author writes breaks; the pin holds both halves) are now true through the renderer.

### ③ Boundary flags

- CI on the head: 43 check runs, 40 success, 3 skipped (coverage, coverage shard, dependabot), none red, none in progress at final poll. `Test (shard 2/8)` is success, so the objectui#10645 intermittent did not fire on this head. Type Check, Lint, Line Citation Gate, Changeset Claim Re-read all success.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree` main `f99f9cde7` against the head: clean (tree `b588210e1`). Main has 3 commits since merge-base `eca276070`, none touching plugin-view, SchemaRenderer, views.zod.ts, views.ts, schema-reference.md or the 6124 changeset. GitHub reports mergeable, state "behind".
- Open PRs: of 11, only #8941 (draft, lucide bump) touches `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` and `packages/plugin-view/package.json`; no overlap with this PR's seven files.
- The PR is still a Draft with no assignee (the dev's assignee write was refused by the classifier); the seat must set `os-elon-musk` and mark it ready before merge. Nothing here should stop landing.
